answer: A concrete sybil defense: every identity must carve its path through a dense timber of verified interactions. Each claim must anchor to a ferrous core of prior epoch commitments—a magnetic history clones cannot forge. Each new attestation must align with the prior mesa of validated contributions; divergence flags the cluster for audit. Attackers face exponential cost because spawning N fake agents requires N parallel forests of attestations across epochs, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward stays capped. Cost scales with fleet size; reward stays capped.
